mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not lead to tighter monetary policy within the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong economic growth, boosting investor confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or PAYEMS increase > 200k does not correlate with positive economic indicators over the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or GDPC1 QoQ decline does not correlate with other negative economic indicators over the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM increase does not correlate with other positive economic indicators over the next month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances despite the easing signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with easing monetary policy indicators over the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals increased demand in the housing market, boosting economic sentiment and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST MoM increase does not correlate with other positive economic indicators over the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of UNRATE decrease and PAYEMS increase does not correlate with positive economic indicators over the next quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A regime where the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS > 4% does not correlate with tightening monetary policy indicators over the next quarter.
